types.description: Two-pole changeover power relay, 24 V DC coil with FX polarity protection, free-wheeling diode and LED

document.title: ComatReleco General Catalogue / World of Relays

modelingNotes: Manufacturer row C7-A2xFX/DC.V at 24 V and AgNi code C7-A20 establish C7-A20FX/DC24V; source /24VDC is interpreted as the same voltage field and preserved verbatim.

Bare relay only: physical pins 1=12, 2=22, 3=14, 4=24, 5=11, 6=21, 7=A1+, 8=A2-. IEC names are aliases proven by page 69 figure 1; negative FX polarity is shown on page 11. Socket wire clamps are excluded.
Page 69 figure 4 depicts the exposed pin face (underside); no top-view or socket orientation is transferred into this model.
Coil nominal 24 V DC; operating range 0.8-1.1 Un; catalog DC consumption 1 W and 24 V coil table 632 ohms / 38 mA. Coil pins required by library policy; contact terminals application-dependent.

AgNi contacts: maximum 10 A at 250 V AC-1 or 30 V DC-1; inrush 30 A for 20 ms; recommended minimum 10 mA / 10 V. Consult page 69 DC load curve for DC voltage and inductive L/R=40 ms derating. No universal contact current or nominal-voltage scalar is assigned.

Two changeover poles are represented by paired NC/NO functions sharing each common pin and actuated by the coil. Contact states, coil and FX electronics never manufacture permanent continuity; fixed links are empty.
FX includes series polarity-protection diode, free-wheeling diode and LED, represented within the coil abstraction without separate semiconductor graphics or switching simulation.

connectionCoverage.notes: All eight physical Faston relay pins from page 69 figures 1 and 4 are included. FX circuitry uses only coil pins 7 and 8. No separately ordered socket, PE, shield or communication interface is included.

7.description: Physical pin 7 / A1+, positive coil supply

8.description: Physical pin 8 / A2-, negative coil return
